concerns.text: Task T015c (Orchestration Halt Logic) is marked as incomplete [ ]. The Spec Edge Cases and Plan 'Verified Accuracy Gate' require a mechanism to halt the pipeline if a degenerate dataset is detected. Without a completed task to implement this logic (e.g., a wrapper script or Makefile rule), the pipeline cannot enforce the required halt behavior, leaving the 'Degenerate Dataset' edge case unhandled.

Task T021 (Model Training) is marked as incomplete [ ]. This task is the sole implementation for FR-004 (Train GB/MLP) and FR-005 (Report Metrics). It also generates the `X_raw.csv` and `X_derived.csv` subsets required by FR-010. Its incompleteness means the core predictive capability (US-2) and all downstream tasks (T027, T028, T030+) have no executable coverage.

Tasks T030 (Load Model), T033a (SHAP CI & Perm for Selected), and T033c (SHAP CI & Perm for Non-Selected) are marked as incomplete [ ]. These tasks implement FR-006 (SHAP plots) and FR-007 (Statistical Significance). Without them, the project cannot satisfy the 'Explainability and Statistical Analysis' requirement (US-3).

Task T035 (Separate Model Comparison) is marked as incomplete [ ]. This task implements the comparison logic required by FR-010 (No multicollinearity) and US-3 Acceptance Scenario 3. Its absence leaves the requirement to 'validate physical intuition' by comparing raw vs. derived models unimplemented.

Task T059 (Contract Test for Dataset Schema) is marked as incomplete [ ]. While T004b creates the schema, T059 is the specific task to validate the final `cleaned_316L.csv` against it. Without this, SC-004 (Data completeness) and the contract enforcement layer lack a dedicated verification task.

Task T031b is tagged with `<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->` and marked incomplete. The description references T031b as a dependency for T033c, but T033c is also incomplete. This creates a circular dependency of incomplete tasks for the non-selected model analysis, preventing the generation of required artifacts for comparison.

Task T015c is marked incomplete but T015 is marked complete. T015 describes the detection logic (writing the flag), while T015c describes the orchestration logic (halting). The separation is valid, but the incompleteness of T015c breaks the flow. Ensure T015c is implemented to satisfy the 'halt' requirement.
